RedWallet XBT 8.0.1 (1795050850)

Invoice sharing opens with a QR image. Switch to text before sharing to send the invoice string. In Pay, try the larger, softly glowing invoice field.

Please check the Lightning Settings crash fix on iPhone. Open XBT Lightning Settings, expand or refresh a section, then go back. No payment is needed. If RedWallet closes, send the approximate time and build number through TestFlight feedback.

The built-in XBT Lightning wallet can scan a SHA-256 invoice and show a Kilombino bridge quote for review. You can cancel before payment. This build also supports reusable XBT Lightning offers, an editable node name, and a short background window for the embedded node.

On Receive, native SegWit is the default and Taproot is available. The hardware signer check uses a request that cannot spend funds.
